item.title: Woke ‘The Bride!’ Bombs at Box Office: Crushed by Disney's ‘Hoppers’ – and Even ‘Scream 7’
item.description: Woke ‘The Bride!’ Bombs at Box Office: Crushed by Disney's ‘Hoppers’ – and Even ‘Scream 7’ The Bride!, Warner Brothers’ angry, male-hating, violent, heavy-handed woke movie bombed in its opening weekend, trounced by a family-friendly film – and even by the sixth sequel of a horror-movie satire. The feminist vision of the bride of Frankenstein took in a measly $7,260,000 in its first weekend, despite being shown in 3,304 theaters across the U.S., averaging $2,197 gross per theater.
